description: This file defines the SupervisedStream interface for managing a supervised stream in an Akka Streams-based system. It provides methods to create a source queue, attach termination listeners, shut down, and abort the stream, along with an inner class for returning the source queue and supervised stream instance.

classes.name: SupervisedStream.WithQueue
classes.description: A class encapsulating a source queue along with its supervising stream, providing accessors for both.

methods.name: sourceQueue
methods.description: Creates and returns a source queue with supervision capabilities, along with a supervising stream.

methods.name: whenComplete
methods.description: Registers a consumer to be called upon stream termination, for handling normal or error termination.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the supervised stream gracefully.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the supervised stream with a specified error.
